column1: # delegate registry: one delegation uid per repository (backends agy and codex share it).
#   key   : prefix of the workspace name. The workspace is <dirname(root)>/<key>-<backend>/ (e.g. /code/Projects/quad-agy)
#   root  : main repository path (working tree root)
#   uid   : from 61000 upward. No two repositories share a uid, so a task in one cannot modify the other's worktree.
#           It must not collide with a real user in /etc/passwd (`delegate.sh doctor` checks).
#   setup : command run once as root inside the new worktree right after it is created (`-` for none). Failure only warns.
# A new repository gets the next free uid from `delegate.sh register <root>`. Edit by hand only while no delegation is running.
# This file is edited in place, so HARNESS_DELEGATE_REGISTRY must point at the git clone copy, not a plugin cache copy.
